Fonologiske processer i Fonitterne: 

-	Fronting ( k -> t, g -> d, ng -> n, sj -> s )
-	Backing ( t -> k, d -> g, n -> ng, s -> sj )
-	Stopping ( f -> b, s -> d )

-	H-sering ( r -> h )

-	Glidning ( l -> j )
